definition: Aconitine is a norditerpenoid alkaloid found in aconitum, delphinium, and larkspurs. It activates voltage-gated sodium channels and has been noted for anti-inflammatory and anti-neuralgic effects, as well as use in animal research to produce arrhythmias.
